title: 俗世凡尘 第19章 水平渡俗世凡尘 第20章 正式入门

“啪”，两只木剑相交，陆多福手腕发麻，出剑顿时迟疑了一下，被对手抓住了机会，一剑刺中胸口。虽然是木剑，对手也没有用全力，也就没受伤，但是火辣辣的很不好受。
“再来！”陆多福顾不得疼痛，很不服气地道。
陪练的弟子看着陆多福鼻青脸肿的样子，淡淡地道：“算了吧，陆师弟。你今日已经是第十七次中剑了，如果这是真剑的话，你都不知道死了多少次了。”
陆多福心有不甘：“不成，刚刚这一招我没用对。再让我试一次吧，王师兄。”
王师兄不为所动，摇头道：“还是算了吧。你之前也是这么说的，结果每次都这样。要我说，你这自创的剑法怕是不行，漏洞百出。这真要上了战场，你都不知道怎么死。”
陆多福尴尬地笑笑，无可辩驳，只好眼巴巴地央求着王师兄再打一次。王师兄看他可怜兮兮的样子，却不为所动。
“王师兄，昨日那坛‘十里香’可还对胃口，要不要再来两坛呐？就咱俩喝是不是有些无趣，要不我们叫上李师叔？”
王师兄正是李师叔的弟子，听陆多福此言，王师兄吓得一个激灵：“别别别，陆师弟，有话好说，不就是切磋一下嘛，师兄答应你就是了。”
云隐门是禁止弟子们喝酒的，但总有人会忍不住犯下戒律。所谓吃人嘴软，拿人嘴短。王师兄昨日收了陆多福一坛子酒，满足了口腹之欲。如今把柄攥在陆多福手里，只好任他驱使。
“这就对了嘛，咱们师兄弟谁跟谁呀。师兄先陪小弟练会，小弟那还藏了几坛，一会给师兄拿过来。”
想到那美酒的滋味，王师兄不由得咽了下口水，说道：“一言为定，师弟请。”
“好嘞，师兄小心了！”
重新交手，陆多福的多福剑式又多了数种变化。王师兄心里暗暗佩服，这个小师弟，虽然实力较弱，但是有个习惯很好，每一招剑法里的破绽，他只会漏出一次，一旦被抓住落败，第二次交手时他必定进行变招。陆多福不仅会完善自己的剑法，同样也会抓王师兄的破绽。双方交手，算是各有增进。
与这样的对手过招，虽然要收了几分力，但是陆多福这自创剑法变幻反复，有时候冷不丁来一下奇招，也能逼得王师兄手忙脚乱。只不过两人实力差距依旧明显，比上一次多打了十几招后，陆多福还是败下阵来。
这只是陆多福勤练无数个日夜中的一个缩影。他一个武道新人，创出来的“多福剑式”自然破绽不少，练的时候感觉没什么，花里胡哨挺酷炫的，但一打起来就遭罪了，每次都被打得不成人样。
尽管如此，陆多福还是不得不厚着脸皮缠着一些熟识的师兄弟当陪练。一开始有些师兄弟打赢之后还要嘲笑他不自量力，小小年纪自创什么剑法，真是贻笑大方，把陆多福气得不轻。受到的讥讽多了之后，陆多福也麻木了。管他们笑不笑，先把剑法练好再说。
后来可能打的次数多了，师兄弟也习以为常了，反倒是有点心疼起这位执拗的师弟了。每当陆多福找到他们求陪练的时候，师兄弟们都愿意帮他一把，一些修为较高的师兄还帮他指出剑招上的不足。
就这样，靠着厚颜无耻铁面功，陆多福修为增进的同时，多福剑式也越发完善。凭借大海无量和多福剑式，陆多福跟一些修为较弱的师兄弟，已经有了一战之力。但跟同级修为的师兄弟比起来，他的整体实力还是弱了一截。没办法，一个武道新人自创的功法武技，又怎么可能及得上门内先辈创造的绝学。

碧秀峰下的碧波潭。
瀑布从十余丈高的山崖上坠落下来，形成了一个约莫一亩大小的水潭，深浅不一，但最深处也不足一丈。碧波潭的水清澈见底，连条鱼都没有。
在陆多福刚来云隐门的时候，南宫修是不让南宫月和陆多福靠近这个地方。小孩子生性顽劣，万一一不小心在此溺水，那可不是闹着玩的。但最近年来，南宫月和陆多福都长大了，也就取消了这个限制。
陆多福时不时会跑来这游个泳，冲冲凉，很是受用。南宫修一家的话，白云溪母女身为女子，不可能会跑来这么个地方洗澡……南宫修基本上也没空。所以碧波潭这样一个好地方，几乎成了陆多福的专属泳池。
自从上回南宫月教会他游泳后，有碧波潭在，陆多福的水性是越来越好了。通常是一个猛子扎进去，就能围着碧波潭游好几圈，还能在水中做各种花哨动作。不过今日，他却不是来游泳的。此行的目的，是为了练剑。
通过无数次跟同门弟子的交手，陆多福得出一个结论，那就是他的剑法，力量严重不足。武者之间交手，灵力外放，如果双方实力悬殊，强者只凭借剑气就能重创对手。虽然目前跟陆多福对战的这些弟子还没达到凭剑气就可伤人的地步，但是认真动起手来，他们的兵器带起的劲风也能让较为羸弱的陆多福连剑都拿不稳，如果双方兵器相碰的话，更不用说了。
为了强化在阻力中出剑的能力，南宫修给陆多福想的法子就是在碧波潭中练习。为此南宫修还专门找人帮陆多福打造了一柄沉重的大铁剑。等陆多福能在水中将这铁剑使顺手，目的也就达到了。
“嘿，喝……”水面刚好没过胸口，陆多福吃力地挥舞起大铁剑，一招一式地练习着。这铁剑凭空拿起来都觉得沉重，在水中挥舞更为吃力，好几次都打到自己身上。幸好南宫修有先见之明，锻造的时候特意叮嘱铁匠不要开锋。
一剑……两剑……数十剑后，使剑的右臂已然脱力，连剑都拿不起来。陆多福将剑交至左手，继续练习。而左臂的力量更差，挥出十几剑就不行了，于是又换回右手……直至两臂全都酸软无力，再也拿不起剑，陆多福才停下来，上岸穿好衣服打坐修炼灵力。
没有人陪练，也没有人监督，全靠自律与坚持。陆多福在清凉的水潭中，练习了将近一年。从水潭浅处练到水底，再从水底练到瀑布正下方。一开始每次只能挥舞几十剑，到后面每次可以挥出上千剑，而且招式连贯迅捷，甚至还能配合他的月影步。陆多福的多福剑式，已经小有所成。当然，这仅限于他跟修为差不多的对手，面对高手，他的招式依旧破绽百出。
这一年的修炼成果也极其喜人。陆多从武修境五重一路扶摇直上，突破了武师境，现在已到达武师境三重。武修境突破到武师境，这一关没有任何难度，只要是个心智正常的人，又肯下功夫的话，都能办到。但用一年半的时间，从武修境一重提升到武师境三重，这个速度对于别的宗门弟子来说，或许一般，但在云隐门，这算很快的了。
可能会有人问，为什么云隐门庆典比试的时候，上场的各宗门才俊都是武修境，那些人明明已经修炼了好几年的。而陆多福一年半就到武师境三重，这还只能算是一般，这不矛盾吗？
不矛盾，情况是这样的。在十岁之前，一般人都不会去让小孩子去进行修炼，因为那个时候小孩子的灵脉还没完全长成，这个时候着急修炼，会对灵脉产生不可逆的伤害。所以一般要等到十岁以后，才会传授炼气之法，甚至有些宗门会等到十二岁以后。
而孩子开始炼气之后，师长们为了巩固孩子的根基，会特意的将孩子们的炼气期延长，多则三年，少则两年。尤其是云隐门，因为缺乏灵药来辅助，炼气期之后还有个锻体期。就拿南宫月来说，她十一岁开始炼气，练了三年后，又锻体一年，从十五岁才开始修炼灵力。
所以到十四五岁的时候，这些青年才俊可能才正式修炼灵力几个月，修为境界在武修境，这很正常。而陆多福不一样，他没有炼气期和锻体期，而是从十四岁不满的时候直接开始修炼。至于一年半突破到武师境三重，这属于比上不足比下有余。
一些大宗门，对于年轻的天才弟子往往舍得下血本去培养，各种灵丹妙药和神级功法一股脑砸上去，这些弟子的修炼速度自然快得惊人，有的半年内就能从武修境一重突破到武师境，堪称武者里面的非人类。
而云隐门这种小宗门，灵药奇缺不说，功法也一般，就连弟子的资质也是一言难尽。这样一来，大多数人要两到三年才能从武修境突破到武师境，也就不足为奇了。陆多福之所以快一些，一来他的大海无量功法确实还不错，再就是他足够努力。
碧波潭前，陆多福望着这一潭清水，心里有些不舍。一年了，他从未间断过在此修炼，但今日却是最后一天了。按南宫修的说法，现在陆多福修为上去了，力量也凑合了，哪怕在此瀑布中修炼也起不到多大的效果了。改明儿起，陆多福应该去碧秀峰顶，跟南宫月一起修炼，暂时以提升灵力为主。
照例脱去衣服，陆多福向瀑布走去。如果有旁人在，一定会惊掉下巴。因为此时陆多福并不是从水潭底走的，而是四平八稳地走在水面上……
对于武者来说，修为达到一定境界后，飞天遁地无所不能，每个境界都可以获得一些特殊的能力。武修和武师那都是咸鱼，不作讨论。武尊境能产生灵觉，武宗境可以隔空伤人，武王境身体变轻，更为灵活，武皇境可以隔空取物。武皇以上境界……呃，凡人暂时不讨论修仙者的事情。

而就是这种在水面上如履平地，还能施展武技的技能，就是登萍渡水，一般要进入武王境后期才能掌握。但那时是因为武者本身修为高，身轻如燕，自然可以在水面上进退自如，不用专门学习就可以办到。
不过这种技能相对鸡肋，只在水面上有用，所以武王境以前因此几乎没有人会刻意去研习。有这时间，还不如好好修炼，争取早日达到武王境。
可陆多福不一样，他长时间在水里修炼，时间长了，便动了心思。由于陆多福的特殊运气方式，他可以与外界的天地灵气相互激荡，能大幅减轻自身身体的重力，再加上水的浮力，这就能使他掌握了这项技能。
陆多福将这项技能命名为“水平渡”，这是自大海无量之后，他的又一得意创作。美中不足的是，施展水平渡比较耗灵力。

"Pa", the two wooden swords intersected. Lu Duofu's wrist went numb. He hesitated for a moment when he drew the sword. His opponent seized the opportunity and stabbed his chest with his sword. Although it was a wooden sword, the opponent did not use all his strength, so he was not injured, but the burning was very uncomfortable.
"Come again!" Lu Duofu said unconvinced, regardless of the pain.
The training disciple looked at Lu Duofu's bruised nose and face, and said calmly: "Forget it, Junior Brother Lu. This is the seventeenth time you have been hit by the sword today. If this was a real sword, you don't know how many times you have died."
Lu Duofu was unwilling to give in: "No, I didn't use the move right just now. Let me try it again, Senior Brother Wang."
Senior Brother Wang was unmoved, shook his head and said, "Let's forget it. You said the same thing before, but the result is like this every time. If you ask me, your self-created swordsmanship is probably not good and full of loopholes. If you really go to the battlefield, you don't know how to die."
Lu Duofu smiled awkwardly, unable to argue, and could only helplessly beg Senior Brother Wang to hit him again. Senior Brother Wang saw his pitiful appearance, but was unmoved.
"Senior Brother Wang, yesterday's jar of 'Ten Miles of Fragrance' was still to my taste. Do you want to have two more jars? Isn't it boring for just the two of us to drink it? How about we call Uncle Li?"
Senior Brother Wang is Uncle Li's disciple. Hearing Lu Duofu's words, Senior Brother Wang was frightened: "Bye bye, Junior Brother Lu, if you have something to say, why don't we just discuss it with you? Senior Brother, I promise you."
Yunyinmen prohibits its disciples from drinking, but there are always people who can't help but break the rules. It is said that eating people is soft-mouthed and taking advantage of others is short-tempered. Senior Brother Wang received a jar of wine from Lu Duofu yesterday to satisfy his appetite. Now that the handle is in Lu Duofu's hands, he has no choice but to let him drive him.
"That's right. Among our senior brothers, who will follow the other? Senior brother will practice with the younger brother first. The younger brother also has a few jars hidden there. I will bring them to the senior brother later."
Thinking of the taste of that fine wine, Senior Brother Wang couldn't help but swallow his saliva and said, "It's a deal, Junior Brother please."
"Okay, senior brother, be careful!"
When they fought again, Lu Duofu's Duofu sword style had several more variations. Senior Brother Wang secretly admired him. Although this junior brother was weak in strength, he had a good habit. He would only leak out every flaw in his swordsmanship once. Once he was caught and defeated, he would definitely change his moves in the second fight. Lu Duofu will not only perfect his swordsmanship, but also catch the flaws of Senior Brother Wang. The two sides fought each other and each made improvements.
Although it takes a bit of effort to fight against such an opponent, Lu Duofu's self-created sword technique changes repeatedly, and sometimes a sudden and unexpected move can force Senior Brother Wang to panic. However, the gap in strength between the two was still obvious. After playing more than a dozen moves compared to the last time, Lu Duofu was still defeated.
This is just a microcosm of Lu Duofu's countless days and nights of hard training. He is a newcomer to martial arts, and the "Duofu Sword Style" he created naturally has a lot of flaws. When he is practicing, it feels like nothing, and it is very cool with all the bells and whistles, but he suffers when he fights, and he is beaten into disgrace every time.
Despite this, Lu Duofu still had to shamelessly ask some familiar brothers to be his sparring partners. At first, after winning a battle, some of his fellow apprentices would laugh at him for not overestimating his own abilities and for inventing his own swordsmanship at such a young age. This was really laughable and made Lu Duofu very angry. After receiving too much ridicule, Lu Duofu became numb. No matter if they laugh or not, practice your sword skills first.
Later, maybe the beatings became more frequent and the junior brothers got used to it, but they actually felt a little sorry for this stubborn junior brother. Whenever Lu Duofu came to them for training, the brothers were willing to help him, and some of the brothers with higher cultivation levels even helped him point out the shortcomings in his sword moves.
In this way, relying on the shameless Iron Face Kung Fu, while Lu Duofu's cultivation improved, Duofu's sword style also became more and more perfect. Relying on the boundless sea and Duofu sword style, Lu Duofu and some weaker practitionersSenior brothers, we already have the strength to fight. But compared with his fellow disciples at the same level of cultivation, his overall strength is still a bit weaker. There is no way, how can the martial arts and martial arts created by a newcomer in martial arts be as good as the unique skills created by the ancestors in the sect.

The Bibo Pond under Bixiu Peak.
The waterfall fell from a cliff more than ten feet high, forming a pool about an acre in size, with varying depths, but the deepest point was less than one foot. The water in Bibotan is crystal clear, with no fish at all.
When Lu Duofu first came to Yunyinmen, Nangong Xiu didn't let Nangong Yue and Lu Duofu get close to this place. Children are naughty by nature, and if they accidentally drown here, it's no joke. But in recent years, Nangong Yue and Lu Duofu have grown up, so this restriction has been lifted.
Lu Duofu would come here from time to time to swim and take a shower, which was very useful. As for Nangong Xiu's family, it is impossible for Baiyunxi and her daughter to come to such a place to take a bath... Nangong Xiu basically has no time. Therefore, such a good place as Bibotan has almost become Lu Duofu's exclusive swimming pool.
Since Nangong Yue taught him how to swim last time, Lu Duofu's water quality has gotten better and better with Bibotan around. Usually, with one plunge, you can swim around the Bibo Pool several times and perform various fancy moves in the water. But today, he was not here to swim. The purpose of this trip is to practice swordsmanship.
After countless battles with fellow disciples, Lu Duofu came to the conclusion that his swordsmanship was seriously lacking in strength. When warriors fight, their spiritual power is released. If there is a huge disparity in strength between the two sides, the strong one can severely injure his opponent with just his sword energy. Although the disciples currently fighting against Lu Duofu have not yet reached the point where they can injure people with their sword energy, if they start seriously, the strong wind brought by their weapons will make the weaker Lu Duofu unable to even hold the sword steady, let alone if the weapons of the two sides collide.
In order to strengthen the ability to draw a sword in the face of resistance, Nangong Xiu thought of a way for Lu Duofu to practice in the Bibo Pond. For this reason, Nangong Xiu also found someone to help Lu Duofu build a heavy iron sword. When Lu Duofu can use the iron sword smoothly in the water, his goal will be achieved.
"Hey, drink..." The water just reached his chest. Lu Duofu struggled to swing the big iron sword and practiced each move. The iron sword felt heavy even when picked up out of thin air, and it was even more difficult to swing it in the water. It hit myself several times. Fortunately, Nangong Xiu had the foresight to specifically instruct the blacksmith not to strike when forging.
One sword...two swords...tens of swords later, the sword wielder's right arm had lost all strength, and he could not even pick up the sword. Lu Duofu handed the sword to his left hand and continued practicing. The strength of his left arm was even worse, and he couldn't swing more than a dozen swords, so he switched to his right hand... Until both arms were so weak and weak, and he could no longer hold the sword, Lu Duofu stopped, went ashore, got dressed, meditated, and practiced spiritual power.
There is no one to train with or supervise, it all depends on self-discipline and persistence. Lu Duofu practiced in the cool water pool for nearly a year. Practice from the shallow part of the pool to the bottom of the water, and then practice from the bottom of the water to directly under the waterfall. At first he could only wield a few dozen swords at a time, but later on he could swing thousands of swords at a time, and his moves were consistent and fast, and could even coordinate with his Moon Shadow Step. Lu Duofu's Duofu Sword Style has achieved some success. Of course, this is limited to opponents with similar cultivation levels as him. Facing masters, his moves are still full of flaws.
The results of this year's practice are also extremely gratifying. Lu Duo rose from the fifth level of the martial arts realm, broke through to the martial arts master realm, and now has reached the third level of the martial arts master realm. There is no difficulty in breaking through from the martial arts realm to the martial arts master realm. As long as a person with a normal mind is willing to work hard, he can do it. However, it took one and a half years to advance from the first level of the martial arts realm to the third level of the martial arts realm. This speed may be average for other sect disciples, but in Yunyin Sect, this is considered very fast.Yes.
Some people may ask why during the Yunyin Sect celebration competition, the talents from each sect who competed were all in the martial arts realm. Those people have obviously been practicing for several years. And Lu Duofu reached the third level of the martial arts realm in one and a half years, which can only be regarded as average. Isn't this contradictory?
No contradiction, this is the situation. Before the age of ten, most people will not allow children to practice cultivation, because at that time, the child's spiritual veins have not fully grown, and practicing in a hurry at this time will cause irreversible damage to the spiritual veins. Therefore, the method of refining qi is generally not taught until after the age of ten, and some sects will even wait until after the age of twelve.
After the children begin to practice Qi, in order to consolidate the children's foundation, the teachers will deliberately extend the children's Qi practice period, which can be as long as three years or as little as two years. Especially for Yunyin Sect, due to the lack of spiritual medicine to assist, there is a physical training period after the Qi refining period. Take Nangong Yue for example. She started practicing qi at the age of eleven. After practicing for three years, she exercised for another year. She only started practicing spiritual power at the age of fifteen.
Therefore, by the time they are fourteen or fifteen years old, these young talents may have only been formally practicing spiritual power for a few months, and their cultivation level is in the martial cultivation realm. This is normal. But Lu Duofu was different. He did not have a Qi refining period or a physical training period, but started practicing directly when he was less than fourteen years old. As for breaking through to the third level of the martial arts realm in one and a half years, this is more than enough than above.
Some large sects are often willing to spend a lot of money to train young genius disciples, and all kinds of miraculous medicines and god-level exercises are thrown at them. The cultivation speed of these disciples is naturally astonishingly fast. Some can break through from the first level of martial cultivation realm to the martial arts master realm in half a year. They can be called non-human among warriors.
As for a small sect like Yunyin Sect, not to mention the shortage of elixirs, their techniques are mediocre, and even the qualifications of their disciples are hard to describe. In this way, it is not surprising that it takes most people two to three years to break through from the martial arts realm to the martial arts master realm. The reason why Lu Duofu is faster is that his Boundless Sea Kung Fu is indeed pretty good, and also because he works hard enough.
In front of the Blue Wave Pond, Lu Duofu looked at the clear water with some reluctance. He has been practicing here for a year, but today is the last day. According to Nangong Xiu, now that Lu Duofu has improved his cultivation and his strength is adequate, even practicing in this waterfall will not have much effect. Starting tomorrow, Lu Duofu should go to the top of Bixiu Peak to practice with Nangong Yue, focusing on improving his spiritual power for the time being.
As usual, Lu Duofu took off his clothes and walked towards the waterfall. If anyone else were around, their jaws would definitely drop. Because at this time Lu Duofu was not walking from the bottom of the pool, but walking steadily on the water...
For warriors, after reaching a certain level of cultivation, they can fly to the sky and escape from the earth to do anything, and each level can obtain some special abilities. Martial arts cultivators and martial arts masters are just salty fish and will not be discussed. The Martial Master Realm can produce spiritual awareness, the Martial Master Realm can hurt people through the air, the Martial King Realm can make the body lighter and more flexible, and the Martial King Realm can pick up objects from across the air. The realm of Martial Emperor and above... well, mortals will not discuss the matters of immortal cultivators for the time being.
And this kind of skill that can walk on the water like walking on flat ground and can also perform martial arts, that is, climbing across the water, can generally be mastered only after entering the late stage of the Martial King Realm. But at that time, it was because the warrior himself had a high level of cultivation and was as light as a swallow, so he could naturally move forward and retreat freely on the water, and he could do it without special training.
However, this skill is relatively useless and is only useful on the water, so few people in the King of Martial Realm would deliberately learn it. If you have this time, you might as well practice hard and strive to reach the King of Martial Realm as soon as possible.
But Lu Duofu was different. He practiced in the water for a long time, and after a long time, he started to think about it. Due to Lu Duofu's special luck, he can interact with the spiritual energy of the outside world and greatly reduce the gravity of his body. Coupled with the buoyancy of water, this allows him to master this skill.
Lu Duofu used this skillNamed "Horizontal Crossing", this is another of his proudest creations since the Infinite Sea. The fly in the ointment is that performing horizontal transition consumes more spiritual power.
